title: scoreboard/releases.jsonl: one line per release run (contract 1.11.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.11.0. Each line of scoreboard/releases.jsonl is one of these, as one JSON object on one line. Appended by `harness scoreboard append` (and by `harness release` after its score) from a scored run; never edited, reordered or removed (`harness guard scoreboard`). A re-run is a new line with the same tag and the next run number. Advisory: never an input to the gate, a verdict or an exit code. Derived from ScoreboardLine in src/scoreboard/line.ts. Not stable: it may change in a minor release; schemaVersion changes when a reader must.

score.description: null when not measured (never 100 for a missing input).

pr.description: null for a commit straight to main.

author.description: A fact for the per-contributor trend only: never a reason, never for reviewing a person.

run.description: 1 for the tag's first line; a re-run is the next number (a logged deviation, never an edit).

date.description: When the release run ran (its report's ranAt); else when the line was appended.

weightsVersion.description: Which weights, floors, bands and rules scored it; a change is a discontinuity the trends show. null for a confidence.json written before 1.11.0.

masks.description: Masks the release run applied; null without a release report.

masksNeverFired.description: The masks that fired nothing in that run, by id.

journeys.description: Journeys the candidate completed in every run, of the distinct journeys it ran; null without the candidate's capture.

mutants.description: The latest weekly mutants record (mutants.jsonl beside the file) at the time of the line: caught and attributed, of planted. null when there is none.

prs.description: The per-PR risk lines of changes.json; null when change risk was not measured.
